insiders.methodology:
Recipients of Sablier vesting streams created by the Venice treasury wallet, 
        plus the direct 25% TGE cliff transfers the treasury sent the same wallets on 2025-01-24. 
        Staked amounts count only allocation tokens (net transfers into the staking contract), 
        so they can be lower than the wallet's staking balance, which also includes staking rewards.

Staking Rewards.methodology: Tracks VVV minted directly to the staking contract for staker rewards.
